message: Fix placeholder agents.py/tools.py; complete SEC deep-dive rework on main.
content:
# Get an Anthropic API key at https://console.anthropic.com/
ANTHROPIC_API_KEY=your-anthropic-key-here

# Get a Tavily API key at https://app.tavily.com/ — powers the data
# gatherer's live web search for SEC filings, earnings, and valuation.
# Without it the pipeline still runs, but with no live web data.
TAVILY_API_KEY=tvly-your-key-here

# SEC EDGAR requires an identifying User-Agent with a real contact email.
# Format: "Your Name your-app-name contact@email.com"
# Without a compliant UA, companyfacts / ticker-map requests return 403.
SEC_EDGAR_USER_AGENT=Ani Singh ani-research-tool contact@example.com
